Each enum entry has **one** `value: String`. There’s:

- No locale parameter

## How to evolve this to support multiple languages

 Descriptor,
 Github,
 ... StringRes.text(locale: Locale): String =
 when (locale) {
 Locale.EN -> when (this) {
 StringRes.HeroTitle -> "I'm Rok Retar, a developer ..."
 // all EN strings
 }
 Locale.SL -> when (this) {
 StringRes.HeroTitle -> "Sem Rok Retar, razvijalec ..."
 // all SL strings
 }
 }
````

3. **Use it in your UI** by passing the current locale:

 title = StringRes.HeroTitle.text(currentLocale),

 )
 ```
